name: e-invoicing-tr-unit-codes
title: UBL-TR unit of measure codes (e-Fatura)
description: The units of measure that the GİB UBL-TR code list names for unitCode attributes in Turkish e-documents (e-Fatura, e-Arşiv Fatura, e-İrsaliye), with their official Turkish names, the matching UN/ECE Recommendation 20 unit, and the unit set and conversion factor from world-units-of-measure.

sources.title: UBL-TR Kod Listeleri, Versiyon 1.43, Temmuz 2026 (section 1.5 InvoicedQuantity, Ölçü Birim Kodları Listesi), in UBLTR_1.2.1_Kilavuzlar.zip, Gelir İdaresi Başkanlığı, retrieved 2026-11-09
e-Fatura Paketi, schematron/UBL-TR_Codelist.xml (UnitCodeList; package history up to 2026-07-01), Gelir İdaresi Başkanlığı, retrieved 2026-11-05: used for in_schematron
world-units-of-measure (UN/CEFACT Recommendation 20, Revision 17), this repository: used for rec20_name, rec20_status, unit_set and factor_to_base

fields.name: code
fields.description: Unit code written to the unitCode attribute (InvoicedQuantity, DeliveredQuantity and others). References code in world-units-of-measure (units), except KFO.

fields.name: name
fields.description: Turkish name as printed in the GİB code list (upper case in the source).

fields.name: rec20_name
fields.description: English name of the code in Recommendation 20, Revision 17. Empty for KFO, which is not in Rec 20.

fields.name: rec20_status
fields.description: Status of the code in Rec 20: active, deleted (marked X) or deprecated (marked D). Empty when the code is not in Rec 20. GİB accepts all of them.

fields.name: unit_set
fields.description: Unit set the code belongs to in world-units-of-measure (count, mass, volume, length, area, energy); empty when it is in none.

fields.name: factor_to_base
fields.description: Factor to the base unit of unit_set (KİLOGRAM for mass, METRE KÜP for volume, ADET for count): GRAM 0.001, LİTRE 0.001. Empty when unit_set is empty.

fields.name: in_schematron
fields.description: true when the UBL-TR schematron accepts the code (UnitCodeList).
